title: Define top-level UsenetIpfsError enum and error taxonomy
description:
Define a top-level UsenetIpfsError enum in core/src/error.rs with variants for each subsystem: Storage(StorageError), Protocol(ProtocolError), Ipfs(IpfsError), Signing(SigningError), Validation(ValidationError), Io(std::io::Error), Config(ConfigError). Implement std::error::Error. Remove or subsume the existing InvalidGroupName error into ValidationError. Artifact: core/src/error.rs expanded.

Acceptance criteria: all variants compile; each subsystem error is convertible to UsenetIpfsError via From; Display impls produce human-readable messages; no error strings are duplicated
